description: This PHP script generates PDF documents or emails based on templates in the SuiteCRM AOS_PDF_Templates module. It processes template content, populates line items, and sends PDFs via email or outputs them directly.

classes.name: sendEmail
classes.description: Class for sending emails with attachments.

classes.name: templateParser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing and rendering templates.

methods.name: populate_group_lines
methods.description: Populates group lines in the template with line items.

methods.name: populate_product_lines
methods.description: Populates product line items into the template.

methods.name: populate_service_lines
methods.description: Populates service line items into the template.
